name: regai
description: Research Vietnamese law in plain language over a hosted, LLM-free retrieval service exposing 6 MCP tools (search, get_article, get_document, list_related, check_in_force, deep_research).

api_token.title: regai API token
api_token.description: Bearer token for the hosted regai service. Ask the regai maintainer for a token. (For a local dev server started without REGAI_MCP_TOKEN any non-empty value works — to point at a local server, edit mcpServers.url in this plugin's plugin.json.)
